title: English Practice Quiz 0830
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 01: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Not until the report arrived did we begin the review.
Not until the report arrived we did begin the review.
Not until arrived the report did we begin.
Not until the report did arrive we began.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 02: The proposal requires ___ before approval.
options: further consideration
consider further
to further consider
considered further
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 03: Choose the correct phrase:
options: Had I known about the delay, I would have called.
If I would know about the delay, I called.
Had I knew about delay, I call.
If I had know, I would called.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 04: The findings are consistent ___ the earlier assessment.
options: with
to
for
at
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 05: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Neither the manager nor the assistants were available.
Neither the manager nor the assistants was available.
Neither manager or assistants were available.
Neither the manager nor assistants be available.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 06: A 'pragmatic' solution is one that is:
options: Practical and realistic
Purely theoretical
Impossible to implement
Based on emotion alone
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 07: Choose the correct use of 'complement':
options: The new system will complement the existing process.
The system will compliment the process by replacing it.
Please complement her on the award.
The complement was a kind remark.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 08: The report was delayed ___ a shortage of verified data.
options: owing to
although
whereas
despite of
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 09: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Scarcely had we entered when the lights went out.
Scarcely we had entered when lights went out.
Scarcely had entered we when lights went out.
Scarcely we entered when had lights gone.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 10: To 'corroborate' a statement means to:
options: Confirm it with supporting evidence
Withdraw it without explanation
Make it less specific
Translate it into another language
questions.explanation: The first option is correct because it matches the relevant professional concept or standard English usage.
